title: Lindsey Graham highlights meetings with national leaders and addresses critics - Greenville Leader
text:
U.S. Senator Lindsey Graham, representing South Carolina, shared a series of posts on his social media account between March 23 and March 24, 2026, highlighting recent meetings and addressing political opposition.
On March 23, Graham posted about a notable visit: “The King of Politics visits the King of Rock ‘n’ Roll. TCB. What a special day.” The same day, he commented on his political stance and ongoing challenges in the Senate: “My opponents are focused on tearing down President @realDonaldTrump’s key ally in the Senate. I’m focused on delivering results, and I have the record to prove it. Bring it on.”
On March 24, Graham described a meeting with national leaders: “Great meeting with @POTUS, my Senate Republican colleagues, and President Trump’s team about how to make America safer. President Trump is one of the strongest and most decisive commanders in chief in American history.”
Graham has served as a U.S. senator for South Carolina and has chaired the Senate Budget Committee (official website). He also serves on several key committees including Appropriations, Judiciary, and Environment and Public Works. With a background that includes 33 years as a colonel in the U.S. Air Force Reserves (official website), Graham ran for office emphasizing fiscal responsibility and national security.
Raised in Central, South Carolina by a blue-collar family that operated a local restaurant and pool hall (official website), Graham obtained both his undergraduate and law degrees from the University of South Carolina.
